notes: Investigated panel swap during two-finger pinch/pan gesture. Root cause: PanelSwap's dragSourceId is set on the first finger's pointerdown (before the two-finger gesture exists) and is never cleared when startGesture() runs on the second finger. The _multiTouchGestureActive guard in PanelSwap's _onPointerDown only prevents a NEW drag from starting — it does not clear the drag state already established by the first finger. When the first finger lifts, MultiTouchHandler clears _multiTouchGestureActive in its _onPointerUp BEFORE PanelSwap's _onPointerUp fires (same event, synchronous, MultiTouchHandler registered first), so PanelSwap sees the flag as false and executes the swap. Recommended fix: move dragSourceId to shared state (state.dragSourceId) so MultiTouchHandler can clear it in startGesture(). Also add _multiTouchGestureActive guard to PanelSwap's _onPointerMove to prevent dragTargetId from updating during gesture. Wrote change request to _agent_docs/specifications/change-requests/2026-08-01-01-panel-swap-during-multitouch.md. No code changes made per user request — investigation and documentation only.
